scope: Material base de madeira, sem tabuleiro ou objetos pintados.
prompt: Create one original seamless tileable material texture for a premium cheerful cartoon 3D tabletop board game. Square 1024×1024, orthographic top-down flat material scan, warm reddish honey walnut / Brazilian wood tabletop. Rich natural flowing wood grain, fine organic curved fibers, broad subtle plank transitions, polished satin finish, warm caramel, amber and chestnut variation. High-quality stylized realistic wood, subtle enough for gameplay background, not photographic grunge and not flat vector stripes. Even diffuse neutral lighting without directional highlights or cast shadows, all edges seamless/tileable. No board, no game pieces, no furniture outlines, no objects, no decorations, no vignette, no perspective, no text, no logos. This is only a reusable base-color wood material, not a gameplay background screenshot.
